description: This file defines the 'BokehTemplate' class and related custom exceptions for creating Bokeh web applications using a YAML templating framework. It includes methods for parsing YAML interface files, registering custom YAML constructors, and embedding Bokeh components.

classes.name: BokehTemplateParserError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during parsing of interface files.

classes.name: BokehTemplateEmbedError
classes.description: Custom exception for errors during embedding components.

classes.name: BokehTemplate
classes.description: Base class for creating Bokeh web apps with YAML templating, handling YAML parsing, widget creation, and component embedding.

methods.name: _self_constructor
methods.description: Handles the '!self' YAML tag, evaluating 'self' with suffix in the current context.

methods.name: _register_default_constructors
methods.description: Registers default YAML constructors for mappings, sequences, figures, and documents.

methods.name: pre_init
methods.description: Method to be implemented by subclasses for pre-initialization steps.

methods.name: post_init
methods.description: Method to be implemented by subclasses for post-initialization steps.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the BokehTemplate object, registers constructors, and parses interface YAML.

methods.name: include_formatting
methods.description: Loads formatting options from the format_string attribute if present.

methods.name: parse_interface
methods.description: Reads and parses the YAML interface file, storing the interface components.

methods.name: embed
methods.description: Returns embeddable Bokeh components for a given reference.

methods.name: parse_string
methods.description: Utility to parse arbitrary YAML strings for debugging.

methods.name: register_sequence_constructor
methods.description: Class method to register custom YAML sequence constructors.

methods.name: register_mapping_constructor
methods.description: Class method to register custom YAML mapping constructors.
